Graph Engineering, a new focus in agentic engineering as we target the external areas around what makes agents scalable.
For a long time, graph was not feasible because the node itself was brittle which made graph not very useful.

But with the emergence of Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity and more, scaling the agent to a graph has now become feasible as AI adoption grows to bigger use cases.
